# A view-restricted note can be written but never read back

**Claim.** `isViewRestricted: true` is accepted with the same 204 as any other note, and the note is then withheld from API keys entirely: absent from items and not counted in count, so every note the API ever shows has the flag false.

Applies to: `~1people~1{vanId}~1notes/post`, `~1people~1{vanId}~1notes/get`

## Observed exchange

```http
(setup) POST /people/create

{
  "firstName": "Barnaby",
  "lastName": "Quill-{scope}"
}

→ 201
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000001
{
  "vanId": 100000001,
  "status": "Stored"
}
```

_One ordinary note, one restricted. Both are accepted identically._

```http
POST /people/100000001/notes

{
  "text": "Volunteered at the phone bank.",
  "isViewRestricted": false
}

→ 204
```
```http
POST /people/100000001/notes

{
  "text": "Do not publish this.",
  "isViewRestricted": true
}

→ 204
```

_The list has one note. The restricted one is not hidden — it is simply not there._

```http
GET /people/100000001/notes

→ 200
{
  "items": [
    {
      "contactHistory": null,
      "noteId": 100000002,
      "text": "Volunteered at the phone bank.",
      "isViewRestricted": false,
      "category": {
        "noteCategoryId": 0,
        "name": null
      },
      "createdDate": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "isPinned": false
    }
  ],
  "nextPageLink": null,
  "count": 1
}
```
